messages:
emily (release-czar): Heads-up — planning a minor runtime + infra release: v2024.08.16.3. Target deploy window Tues 18:00 UTC. Draft release notes and internal blurb below. Need sign-off on model pin, canary window, rollback command, and a short internal announcement by 17:00 UTC.

jules (qa-lead): LGTM on unit + e2e. There's one flaky around LLM prefix cache invalidation — will add as a Known Issue in RN. I'll run a full smoke at 17:15 and report.

sanjay (eng-oncall): Oncall: 17:45–19:30. I'll monitor p95 latency and 5xx rate. If 5xx spikes >10% over baseline during canary -> escalate to rollback.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> 25% -> 100% rollout. Canary duration: 15m. Rolling update across runtime nodes.

deploy-bot: dry-run completed in staging. Artifact tag: `release/2024.08.16/runtime-optim`. Suggested command:
```
svc deploy --tag release/2024.08.16/runtime-optim --strategy rolling --canary 25 --canary-duration 15m
```

chris (docs): Draft RN copy (please edit):
- Summary: Optimized runtime kernels and KV cache warm-up to reduce tail latency and memory usage.
- Impact: ~10-20% tail p95 improvement for long-context workloads. No schema changes.
- Known issue: cache invalidation may surface stale prefixes in rare cases (Jules is validating).
- Rollback: `svc rollback --to-tag release/2024.08.10/safe` (see runbook).
- Notes for SRE: confirm canary node qps and KV hit ratio metrics.

maya (product): For internal announcement, we should call out the user-facing benefit: lower latency for embeddings & chat flows. Keep one-sentence blurb for #general.

lex (marketing): Draft internal blurb for #general: "Runtime update deployed tonight (18:00 UTC) — reduces chat/embedding latency for long conversations. If your service depends on long-context LLM calls, please verify behavior and report regressions to #support." Short enough?

jules (qa-lead): Adding Known Issue text: "In rare cases, cached prefixes may not be invalidated immediately after a version pin; workaround: flush KV cache per-pod: `kubectl exec -c runtime -- /usr/local/bin/kv-flush`" Will verify fix.

emily (release-czar): Model pinning: propose pinning `model/redwood-open-3b@v1.2.0-quant` for Dedicated test tenants during rollout, with automated fallback to `model/redwood-open-3b@v1.1.9` if latency regressions >15%. Can people ack?

sanjay (eng-oncall): Ack for pin + fallback policy. Add metric alert on `model_latency.p95` and `model_error.rate`.

chris (docs): I'll add the Known Issue + rollback snippet to the internal RN page and link the runbook: https://intranet/release-runbook/runtime-rollout.

emily (release-czar): Quick checklist:
- [ ] Docs RN updated (Chris)
- [ ] QA smoke done (Jules @17:15)
- [ ] Oncall present (Sanjay)
- [ ] Marketing internal blurb (Lex)
- [ ] Deploy dry-run (passed)
If no objections by 17:00 UTC I will trigger the deploy as scheduled.

lex (marketing): Tiny edit to blurb: add "contact @support if you see regressions" — other than that, 👍.

jules (qa-lead): Smoke passed at 17:22 — saw one cache invalidation event but no customer-facing regression in staging. Marking Known Issue present.

emily (release-czar): Thanks — rolling forward at 18:00 UTC. Will post internal announcement to #general after canary completes. If anyone wants to delay, speak up now.

ops-bot: canary started at 18:00 UTC — 25% traffic to 3 nodes. Monitoring enabled for 15m.

deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot: p95 latency -8%, errors stable. Proceeding to full rollout.

emily (release-czar): Full rollout completed 18:28 UTC. Internal announcement posted to #general. Closing thread — great job team :tada:
